sections.title: Austin's FinTech acceleration
sections.description: Austin's FinTech market has accelerated dramatically from its consumer finance and payment processing roots.

blocks.heading: California company migration
paragraphs: Numerous financial services companies have relocated or expanded to Austin following California's regulatory and tax environment changes — including Schwab's headquarters consolidation to Texas, USAA's large San Antonio presence (adjacent Austin market), and the venture capital and private equity firms opening Austin offices. This migration has brought sophisticated financial services technology talent and culture to Austin's already strong technology ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Texas' digital banking regulatory accessibility
paragraphs: Texas has historically been among the more accessible US states for new banking and financial technology regulatory entry — the Texas Department of Banking and the Texas Finance Commission have shown willingness to work with innovative financial technology companies on novel business models that more conservative state regulators have declined.

blocks.heading: Austin's payments innovation community
paragraphs: The payments technology community that has grown in Austin — particularly around Dell Technologies' large procurement and financial systems and the Apple Austin campus's payments security work — has created a foundation for payments AI development that extends beyond the obvious Schwab and USAA anchor employers.
